Intuitive cockpit ergonomics include Command Link instrumentation, which provides easy access to onboard instrumentation. Its theater-style, 3-person Cruiser® seat features new double top stitching for all-day comfort when three-up touring. Fast-access stern storage and an extra-large swim platform round out its full list of amenities.
